cases.explain: «Правая рука» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: Your right hand, Yahweh, is glorious in power. Your right hand, Yahweh, dashes the enemy in pieces.

cases.sentence: Когда лошади, колесницы и всадники фараона вошли в море, Господь обрушил на них ___.
cases.explain: «морские воды» — the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: For the horses of Pharaoh went in with his chariots and with his horsemen into the sea, and Yahweh brought back the waters of the sea on them; but the children of Israel walked on dry land in the middle of the sea.

cases.sentence: Моисей повел израильтян от ___, и они вошли в пустыню Сур.
cases.explain: «Красного моря» — after the preposition «от», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: Moses led Israel onward from the Red Sea, and they went out into the wilderness of Shur; and they went three days in the wilderness, and found no water.
